args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west; error rate ~0.18). Identified v2.3.1 as the bad deploy, with v2.3.0 being the most recent healthy release in production. Performed a rollback to v2.3.0 across all production regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error), but a retry completed the rollback successfully; all regions are now on v2.3.0. On-call has been paged to investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created successfully despite the timeout (INC-0001), so no retry is needed. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions.** The first attempt partially failed (only us-east updated, due to an orchestrator error), but a retry completed successfully — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0", describing the failed deploy, the rollback (including the partial failure and successful retry), and noting the need to investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures. The incident creation call reported a timeout, but I verified the incident exists and is open — the on-call engineer has been paged.
